title: AIOW commercial control plane v1
description: Executable closed authority. The instance is exactly one wire or projection variant.

TrustedServerTime.x-aiow-trusted-writer: server clock only; caller values are rejected

leaseExpiresAt.x-aiow-trusted-writer: database transaction time plus fixed lease duration; never caller time
persisted database lease expiry; never caller time

quotePdfV1.bodyAuthority: exact PDF bytes and SHA-256 durably accepted by the committed QuoteCommitACK
quotePdfV1.replay: same endpoint-scoped idempotency key and canonical digest returns the original status, headers and identical PDF bytes

mail_run.batchSemantics: operation=mail_run; execute only: one HTTP 200 OutboxBatchACK; requestedLimit equals authenticated parsed request.limit; ordered items length 0..limit contains every and only jobs claimed by this run; in_progress and replay never invoke executeMailOutboxRun

idempotency.bodyDigest: lowercaseHexSha256(rawRequestBodyBytes) from exact bytes authenticated by x-aiow-internal-hmac
idempotency.requestId: immutable correlation stored only on first insert; not part of uniqueness; every later ACK/header/body uses that original request ID
idempotency.begin: after HMAC and body validation call aiow_mail_run_begin_v1 with exact authenticated incoming requestId, key, digest and derived workerId; only execute may invoke worker
idempotency.execute: invoke executeMailOutboxRun exactly once for current mail-run lease, then call aiow_mail_run_complete_v1 and durably commit the declared response before HTTP response bytes

inProgress.requestId: original persisted request_id even when the incoming authenticated request ID differs

idempotency.replay: return exact stored responseStatus, closed responseHeaders and RFC 8785 canonical responseBody bytes with original persisted request_id; do not invoke worker
idempotency.completeFailure: return unstored 503 unavailable; never issue a second provider call in the request; expired mail-run execution may run again, while the durable outbox leased/sent fence prevents every accepted or possibly accepted job from a second provider call

workerIdentity.failure: configured values outside the pattern/length fail closed with HTTP 503 unavailable before begin or worker execution

orderedSteps: require HTTPS before reading application data; otherwise return 401 Error unauthenticated
read the exact raw request-body bytes once and require the five declared headers with exact syntax

compute lowercaseHexSha256(rawRequestBodyBytes), construct x-aiow-internal-hmac canonical bytes, enforce inclusive +/-300 second server-clock tolerance, and constant-time compare HMAC-SHA256 before JSON parsing

parse the authenticated raw bytes exactly once as UTF-8 JSON and require the closed body {limit: integer 1..50}; malformed encoding, JSON, content type, shape or limit returns HTTP 400 Error invalid_request without begin or worker execution
derive workerId only from private server configuration AIOW_MAIL_WORKER_ID using the declared pattern/length/default; never accept it from request data
call aiow_mail_run_begin_v1(p_request_id=authenticated X-AIOW-Request-Id, p_idempotency_key=exact Idempotency-Key, p_body_digest=raw-body SHA-256, p_worker_id=derived workerId)
on execute invoke executeMailOutboxRun({limit: parsedBody.limit, workerId, store: commercialMailOutboxStoreV2, provider: microsoftGraphMailProvider}) exactly once for that mail-run lease

validate the execute result as operation=mail_run OutboxBatchACK, build status 200 with closed no-store headers carrying the original receipt requestId, and call aiow_mail_run_complete_v1 with exact begin identity/token and response fields before writing HTTP bytes

if executeMailOutboxRun throws or its result is invalid, build closed HTTP 503 Error unavailable with the original receipt requestId and retriable=true, then attempt aiow_mail_run_complete_v1 before writing HTTP bytes
on in_progress return HTTP 409 Error idempotency_in_progress with retriable=true and the original persisted requestId; do not invoke worker or complete
on replay return exact stored responseStatus, responseHeaders, and serializeMailRunResponseBodyV1 canonical responseBody bytes with the original persisted requestId; do not invoke worker or complete

if complete fails or conflicts, return an unstored HTTP 503 Error unavailable and do not call the provider again in this request; expired mail-run execution may later run, but stale leased outbox jobs are fenced to review and sent jobs are unclaimable

aiow_mail_run_complete_v1.all_sqlstate_conflict_connectivity_unexp: 503 unavailable unstored response; never call provider again in this request

routeAlgorithm.responseSerialization: all initial completed and replay responses parse directly as exactly their advertised OutboxBatchACK or Error body; no stored-response envelope is written to HTTP

preAuthCorrelation.source: server-generated cryptographically random lowercase UUID for every non-HTTPS, missing/malformed header, stale timestamp, or bad-signature response
preAuthCorrelation.binding: the same generated UUID appears in Error.requestId and MailRunResponseHeaders.xAiowRequestId
preAuthCorrelation.incomingRequestId: never trusted or echoed before successful HMAC authentication

aiow_mail_run_begin_v1.name: aiow_mail_run_begin_v1
aiow_mail_run_begin_v1.identity: registered endpoint + idempotency_key only; table primary key is idempotency_key; request_id is immutable first-request correlation and is returned on every execute/in_progress/replay ACK even when a later authenticated request ID differs
aiow_mail_run_begin_v1.atomicity: one transaction takes a transaction-scoped advisory lock on collision-resistant hash of the complete idempotency_key then SELECT FOR UPDATE on the existing receipt; INSERT races resolve by reselecting the key, yielding exactly one first insert/execute

stateMachine.missing: insert original request_id, pending revision=1 with fresh token and lease_expires_at=transaction_timestamp()+300 seconds; execute using original request_id
stateMachine.pending_unexpired: same key+digest returns in_progress with immutable original request_id without changing revision/token/expiry and without worker execution, regardless of incoming request ID
stateMachine.pending_expired: same key+digest increments revision once, replaces worker_id, token and expiry from trusted server time, and executes using immutable original request_id; incoming request ID never replaces it
stateMachine.completed: same key+digest replays original exact status, headers, body, completed_at and request_id; never execute
stateMachine.digest_conflict: same key with any changed digest returns stable idempotency_conflict without mutation for every request ID

aiow_mail_run_begin_v1.digestConflict: checked under the key lock before every state branch; changed digest is 409 without mutation; same digest ignores incoming request ID for identity and preserves original request_id

lease.takeover: only when transaction_timestamp() >= persisted lease_expires_at; changes token and increments revision once

aiow_mail_run_begin_v1.raceSemantics: concurrent missing-row begins for one key serialize through advisory lock/unique primary key; winner inserts original request_id and execute; loser reselects and returns in_progress (or replay if completion wins), always with winner request_id; no unique violation escapes

aiow_mail_run_complete_v1.name: aiow_mail_run_complete_v1
aiow_mail_run_complete_v1.cas: same key advisory/row lock; pending + exact original request_id/digest/current token only; wrong token/state/request_id is revision_conflict, changed digest is idempotency_conflict
aiow_mail_run_complete_v1.responseValidation: status, headers and body validated as one correlated MailRunStoredResponse: 200 requires mail_run OutboxBatchACK; 503 requires closed Error; headers closed no-store; malformed/undeclared invalid_request
aiow_mail_run_complete_v1.completion: atomic update stores only validated response fields, state completed, completed_at=updated_at=transaction_timestamp(); returns completed; no caller timestamp
aiow_mail_run_complete_v1.replay: repeated exact completion returns replay only when token, digest, status, headers and RFC 8785 canonical body bytes equal stored completion; otherwise conflict; original never changes

aiow_mail_run_receipts_delete_expired_v1.name: aiow_mail_run_receipts_delete_expired_v1
aiow_mail_run_receipts_delete_expired_v1.deletion: SECURITY DEFINER derives cutoff internally as transaction_timestamp() - interval '90 days' and deletes at most p_limit completed receipts older than that trusted cutoff in stable idempotency_key order; no caller cutoff/key/request ID; application service_role has neither EXECUTE nor direct DELETE

aiow_mail_outbox_claim_v2.name: aiow_mail_outbox_claim_v2
aiow_mail_outbox_claim_v2.batchSemantics: claim: one JSON batch ACK row; ordered items length 0..p_limit; every transitioned lease appears exactly once with full owner/token/expiry/payload digest/revision

aiow_mail_outbox_dead_v2.name: aiow_mail_outbox_dead_v2
aiow_mail_outbox_dead_v2.resultBoundary: permanent_pre_acceptance only; an exhausted transient is first server-classified as permanent code retry_exhausted, then finalized dead

aiow_mail_outbox_recover_stale_v2.name: aiow_mail_outbox_recover_stale_v2
aiow_mail_outbox_recover_stale_v2.batchSemantics: stale_recovery: atomically transition every selected expired leased job, at attempts 1..5, to review; clear lease fields/next_attempt_at; persist ProviderAmbiguous {schemaKind:provider_ambiguous,category:ambiguous,code:unknown_acceptance,receipt with null acceptance}; one ordered JSON batch ACK reports each transitioned lease snapshot exactly once; never retry or dead automatically
aiow_mail_outbox_recover_stale_v2.recoveryFence: leased is a durable pre-dispatch fence: expiry cannot prove Graph non-acceptance, so every expired lease becomes review/unknown_acceptance for all attempt counts and is never claimable until explicit ops_admin resolution

runtimeValidation.currentValidator: validateProviderGateCurrentV1 for approved/activated writes and returned current records

aiow_active_customer_relation_set_v1.name: aiow_active_customer_relation_set_v1
aiow_active_customer_relation_set_v1.effect: set_active_customer_relation ACK; previousRevision + 1 = revision = projection.revision; effect.activeCustomerRelation equals projection.activeCustomerRelation; replay returns byte-equivalent persisted ACK

atomicTransition.selection: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, ordered by quote.expires_at then quote.id, at most p_limit; quote.state=prepared; quote.expires_at < trusted transaction_timestamp and <= p_expired_before; common lead status is nonterminal; commercial_leads.legal_hold=false; commercial_leads.active_customer_relation=false; no committed quote and no active relation
atomicTransition.cas: the locked quote remains prepared and the common lead remains at its selected revision/status through the write
atomicTransition.transaction: in one transaction set lead.status=lost, increment lead.revision exactly once, set trusted terminal_at and abandoned_at to the same transaction timestamp, set quote.state=abandoned, and insert one immutable audit row
atomicTransition.ack: return every and only transitioned row as QuoteAbandonBatchACK; revision=previousRevision+1 and terminalAt=abandonedAt
atomicTransition.noOp: replay or no eligible rows returns the same closed QuoteAbandonBatchACK with itemCount=0 and items=[]; committed, nonexpired, held, active-relation, terminal, or otherwise ineligible rows remain unchanged
atomicTransition.bookingFailure: failed public bookings are never committed and create no retention row; there is no booking-failure abandonment writer

transportDigestOverrides.mail_run: identity is registered endpoint + exact Idempotency-Key only; exact raw-body SHA-256 is conflict digest; X-AIOW-Request-Id is immutable first-request correlation, not identity or digest input

x-aiow-lifecycle.acceptedNonReplayMutation: increments revision exactly once; stamps configured actor ID and server time; writes one immutable audit row atomically

terminalAnchors.trustedWriter: aiow_commercial_mutate_v1 transition_status and aiow_quote_abandon_expired_v1 atomic prepared-expiry transition only; both use transaction server time after row-lock/CAS checks; clients, providers, mail and analytics cannot write terminal_at
terminalAnchors.firstTerminalTransition: a nonterminal -> won/lost accepted non-replay transition stamps terminal_at exactly once with transaction server time and increments revision once
terminalAnchors.terminalReplayOrNoOp: idempotent replay returns the persisted outcome and repeated terminal/no-op requests neither restamp terminal_at nor increment revision
terminalAnchors.lostReopen: lost -> qualified clears both terminal_at and abandoned_at atomically after expectedRevision CAS, increments revision once, and makes the lead retention-ineligible while active
terminalAnchors.reterminalization: a later qualified/nonterminal -> won/lost accepted transition stamps a fresh terminal_at using transaction server time
terminalAnchors.eligibility: terminal_at is eligible only while status is won/lost; legal_hold or active_customer_relation suspends retention without changing anchor age

projection.revision = revision
effect equals the operation-specific projection field after mutation
replayed=true returns byte-for-byte the originally persisted ACK including revisions, projection, effect, auditId, actorId and serverTime
approvedAt <= serverNow < expiresAt
approvalBindingSha256 equals SHA-256 of canonical JSON over exactly PROVIDER_GATE_APPROVAL_FIELDS; that frozen runtime list must equal x-aiow-provider-gate.approvalBinding byte-for-byte
expired or revoked state removes mail_send capability immediately
providerGateCurrentV1.clock: trusted database transaction_timestamp; never caller time

rules: operation equals endpoint/RPC operation
requestedLimit exactly equals request limit and is 1..50
itemCount equals items.length and length is at most requestedLimit
every item has the complete lease fields and IDs and lease tokens are unique
items are strictly ordered by the exact tuple nextAttemptAt null-first, createdAt, id
itemCount equals items.length and length is at most the exact request limit
every accepted item increments revision exactly once, status=lost, quoteState=abandoned and terminalAt=abandonedAt
quote IDs and commercial lead IDs are unique
headers exact JSON content type, no-store and matching request ID
200 only valid mail_run OutboxBatchACK; 503 only closed Error
headers/body RFC 8785 canonicalized before storage/replay for byte-identical output
identity/digest match authenticated request
execute token/expiry; in_progress expiry without token; replay exact stored response
persisted response comparison exact
completed/replay carry valid exact stored response
persisted response comparison exact

x-aiow-internal-hmac.canonicalBytes:
UTF-8(method + "
" + canonicalPath + "
" + timestamp + "
" + requestId + "
" + idempotencyKey + "
" + lowercaseHexSha256(rawRequestBodyBytes))
x-aiow-internal-hmac.canonicalPath: exact registered path, no query string or normalization
x-aiow-internal-hmac.bodyDigest: SHA-256 of exact raw request body bytes, lowercase hex
x-aiow-internal-hmac.replay: mail_run endpoint + idempotencyKey are durable identity; exact raw-body SHA-256 is conflict digest; first authenticated requestId is immutable correlation and later same-key/same-digest requests return it on in_progress/replay; timestamp validation occurs before begin

mailRunAuthority.requestBinding: exact HMAC incoming requestId, key and raw-body digest plus private AIOW_MAIL_WORKER_ID passed unchanged to begin; endpoint+key is identity and first requestId is immutable correlation; no caller time
mailRunAuthority.workerFence: outbox claim commits leased before any Graph HTTP; mail-run only execute invokes worker; expired mail-run may execute again, but sent is unclaimable and stale leased always becomes review/unknown_acceptance rather than retry/dead
mailRunAuthority.durabilityFence: completion commits exact response before HTTP write; complete failure returns unstored unavailable; crash matrix proves accepted/possibly accepted outbox jobs cannot reach a second provider call
